# A comment above the value of a map entry is written above the key, since
# a comment after the colon is not found when the output is formatted again.
celfmt -i value.cel -o out1.cel
! stderr .
cmp out1.cel want_value.txt

celfmt -i out1.cel -o out2.cel
! stderr .
cmp out1.cel out2.cel

# The same for a comment that -s moves into a map by inlining a variable.
celfmt -s -i inlined.cel -o out3.cel
! stderr .
cmp out3.cel want_inlined.txt

celfmt -s -i out3.cel -o out4.cel
! stderr .
cmp out3.cel out4.cel

# Comments above the key stay above it, before comments above the value.
celfmt -i both.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_both.txt

-- value.cel --
{
	"a":
		// c
		state.x,
	"b": state.y,
}
-- want_value.txt --
{
	// c
	"a": state.x,
	"b": state.y,
}
-- inlined.cel --
// top
(
	state.x
).as(y, {"a": y})
-- want_inlined.txt --
{
	// top
	"a": state.x,
}
-- both.cel --
{
	// key
	"a":
		// value
		state.x,
}
-- want_both.txt --
{
	// key
	// value
	"a": state.x,
}
